#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Space Engineers server — generated by provision().
# Settings: <ROOT>/installs/spaceengineers/gamedash-servers/test/SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
# keep the join password in step with the ones set in GameDash (the game stores it salted and hashed)
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/spaceengineers/gamedash-servers/test/SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import base64, hashlib, os, re, sys
p, pw = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
salt = os.urandom(16)
digest = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha1", pw.encode("utf-8"), salt, 10000, 32)
t = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
for tag, val in (("ServerPasswordHash", digest), ("ServerPasswordSalt", salt)):
    t = re.sub(r"<%s>[^<]*</%s>|<%s ?/>" % (tag, tag, tag),
               lambda m: "<%s>%s</%s>" % (tag, base64.b64encode(val).decode(), tag), t)
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(t)
SYNC
export WINEPREFIX="<ROOT>/home/.wine-gd-spaceengineers-test"
export WINEDEBUG=-all
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="   # no Mono/Gecko install prompts (headless)
# Run headless: Wine would otherwise open a console window on the desktop
# session (unsetting DISPLAY alone isn't enough — it falls back to Wayland).
unset DISPLAY
export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-none
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES=""        # this server needs the .NET runtime (mscoree) left enabled
if [ ! -f "$WINEPREFIX/.gamedash-runtimes" ]; then
    # One-off, 10-30 minutes: put Microsoft's .NET 4.8 and Visual C++ runtimes into
    # this server's Wine environment. The server refuses to start without them.
    echo "gamedash: preparing the Wine environment (.NET 4.8 + Visual C++) — this takes a while the first time"
    xvfb-run -a winetricks -q dotnet48 || exit 1
    # the Visual C++ runtime straight from Microsoft (winetricks' copy installed
    # files for the wrong processor type in testing)
    mkdir -p "$WINEPREFIX/drive_c/gamedash" || exit 1
    curl -fsSL -o "$WINEPREFIX/drive_c/gamedash/vc_redist.x64.exe" https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe || exit 1
    xvfb-run -a wine "$WINEPREFIX/drive_c/gamedash/vc_redist.x64.exe" /quiet /norestart || exit 1
    wineserver -w
    touch "$WINEPREFIX/.gamedash-runtimes"
fi
cd "<ROOT>/installs/spaceengineers/DedicatedServer64" || exit 1
# No -ignorelastsession: with it every start reloads the blank starting world and the saved
# one is discarded. Without it the server continues the last saved session.
exec xvfb-run -a wine ./SpaceEngineersDedicated.exe -console -path "Z:<WINROOT>\\installs\\spaceengineers\\gamedash-servers\\test"
